newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican lawmakers exempt pension funds from VAT.
newsitem.headline: Mexican lawmakers exempt pension funds from VAT.

text.p: Mexico's Chamber of Deputes on Wednesday approved a modification to the law that will exempt commissions paid to pension fund management firms (Afores) from being charged value added tax.
The measure was overwhelmingly approved, with only three votes against and 17 absentions from the center-left Party of the Democratic Revolution.

It changes the VAT law to spare workers from paying tax on their commissions to the Afores. The commissions, which will be paid from July onwards, have already been criticized for being too high and a burden on workers.
